scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: AtomRec: Evolving Atomic Memory for Agentic Recommendation
papers.authors: Hu, Peiyu, Lu, Weihai, Gu, Siying, Liu, Zhuodong, Luo, Zhaokai, Niu, Yuean, Wang, Zhiyong, Wang, Jia
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.04882v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Agentic recommender systems use large language models to maintain semantic memory and support evidence-aware recommendation. However, existing memory mechanisms often compress user and item information into coarse summaries and connect them with scalar collaborative links, making it difficult to preserve fine-grained preference stages or retrieve interpretable evidence as user interests evolve. We propose \textsc{AtomRec}, an agentic recommender with evolving atomic collaborative memory. \textsc{AtomRec} represents user and item memories as structured atomic units, builds semantic links across related memories, and evolves related historical fields when new interactions arrive. During recommendation, it retrieves linked memories as multi-hop evidence paths rather than isolated neighbor summaries, allowing collaborative signals to support grounded ranking. Experiments on four public benchmarks show that \textsc{AtomRec} consistently outpe
papers.summary: AtomRec 把用户与内容历史拆成带关键词、标签、时间和关联链接的原子记忆，用大模型更新局部字段，再沿两跳语义路径汇集证据完成推荐。四个公开基准上相对最强基线平均提升约 8.5%；Books 的 NDCG@5 从 MemRec 的 0.6480 升至 0.7130，主实验每次仅重排 10 个候选。
papers.key_insight: 社区 UGC 搜索可借鉴其可局部修订的兴趣记忆，将当前 query 与历史点击、收藏证据共同用于小候选集重排。应优先验证细粒度记忆是否减少兴趣漂移后的误排，并严格按请求时间构造快照；论文未提供线上 CTR 或并发延迟结果，不能将离线约 8.5% 的收益直接视为生产增益。
papers.scoring_rationale: 细粒度兴趣与语义证据直接契合社区内容发现；结构化记忆有清晰创新，四基准和消融充分，但依赖闭源 LLM 且无生产延迟验证，实用性为 3。
papers.track_rationale: 核心任务是 LLM-as-recommender 的候选推荐，按技能归 generative；并非通用 Agent 搜索。
papers.evidence_note: 全文表 1、2、12 及附录 C、G、M；实验均为离线，企业 affiliation 不表示已部署。
papers.preference_reason: 生成式/LLM 推荐主题语义匹配 +0.30；业务相关维度 +0.05。

papers.title: Collaborative Memory Augmentation for Generative Recommendation
papers.authors: Liu, Enze, Tian, Zhen, Zhao, Wayne Xin
papers.abstract: Generative Recommendation (GR) has exhibited great potential by modeling item transitions as a sequence-to-sequence task. Despite the success of GR, existing frameworks primarily focus on modeling individual user sequences within a constrained internal parametric space, failing to explicitly leverage cross-user collaborative signals. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{OMEGA}, a cOllaborative MEmory augmentation framework for Generative recommendAtion. OMEGA bridges the gap between implicit parametric knowledge and explicit collaborative signals. We first introduce a latent context compression method that utilizes learnable query tokens to distill sequential user behavior into compact representations, significantly reducing storage overhead. These compressed representations are aggregated into a collaborative memory bank, serving as an explicit repository of global behavioral patterns. To ensure precise knowledge acquisition, we design a lightweight and target-aware retrieval mechanism that identifies pertinent memories by considering both sequence-level and target-level similarities. Furthermore, a context-aware integration module, equipped with a gated cross-attention mechanism, is employed to adaptively fuse the retrieved collaborative memories with the local user context while mitigating the interference of noisy patterns. Empirical evaluations on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that OMEGA significantly outperforms existing advanced GR models, validating the potential of external memory as a complement to the generative paradigm.
papers.summary: OMEGA 为生成式推荐增加跨用户协同记忆：先将行为片段压成少量潜在向量，再按序列与目标相似性检索，并用门控交叉注意力融合。Game 数据集上，TIGER 的 NDCG@5 从 0.0380 升至 0.0470，提升 23.68%；Pctx 从 0.0416 升至 0.0480，提升 15.38%。
papers.key_insight: 短文本社区可把相似用户的行为片段作为生成式召回的外部证据，避免只依赖单个用户的稀疏历史。迁移时应比较全候选 Recall、nDCG 与冷启动分组效果，并按时间限制记忆库；原文批量推理约慢 1%、额外参数约 7%，这些离线测量仍需结合社区候选规模重新评估。
papers.scoring_rationale: 可作为社区生成式召回的协同增强模块；跨骨干与全物品评测较充分，训练和推理开销有实测。原始发表于 8 月 2 日，时效按 37 天计 2 分。
papers.track_rationale: 核心是为 TIGER/Pctx 生成式推荐骨干补充外部协同记忆。
papers.evidence_note: 全文表 2 的 Game 列及表 5；23.68% 与 15.38% 是对应数据集结果，并非所有数据集均值。
papers.preference_reason: 精确命中 generative recommendation +0.30；业务与实用性维度各 +0.05。

papers.title: Distill Globally, Adapt Locally: Reasoning Distillation and Product-Type Test-Time Training for Scalable Trade-Up Recommendation
papers.authors: Liu, Siliang, Ghasemi, Mohammad, Patel, Sapan, Banitalebi-Dehkordi, Amin
papers.abstract: Trade-up recommendation identifies higher-quality alternatives that preserve a customer's purchase intent while offering upgraded benefits. Large language models (LLMs) can reason about such distinctions, but applying them directly to hundreds of millions of product pairs is operationally impractical. We introduce a two-level framework that distills LLM reasoning into an efficient non-generative student and adapts its decision boundary to product-type-specific trade-up criteria. At Level 1, a retrieval-augmented few-shot LLM teacher generates structured relation labels and natural-language rationales. These rationales supervise a compact embedding-pair classifier through alignment and contrastive objectives; at inference, the student uses only two precomputed 768-dimensional product embeddings, with no LLM calls or text generation. On a fixed human-annotated benchmark of 8,352 pairs, a 15.5M-parameter four-class reasoning-distilled student achieves AUC 0.924 (95% CI [0.918, 0.929]), compared with 0.912 for the four-class label-only student. At Level 2, product-type test-time training (PT-TTT) uses few-shot demonstrations to optimize lightweight category-specific adapters over the frozen student. PT-TTT improves AUC from 0.924 to 0.941 and average precision from 0.920 to 0.940. On a 100K-pair proxy catalog, the distilled student on a single eight-GPU machine is approximately 5,000x faster and 10,000x lower in estimated cost than direct LLM inference.
papers.summary: 该工作将 LLM 对商品升级推荐的关系判断与理由蒸馏到 15.5M 参数分类器，再用少量品类样本适配冻结学生。8,352 对人工标注样本上，四分类学生 AUC 从仅标签训练的 0.912 升至 0.924，品类适配后达 0.941；最终服务只读取两条预计算的 768 维商品向量。
papers.key_insight: 对社区搜索，值得试验把大模型对“更符合需求的帖子”的比较理由离线转移给轻量模型，再用主题级少样本校准决策边界。论文证明收益依赖四分类关系监督，二分类加入理由后 AUC 仍为 0.911；其线上学生不生成文本，成本倍率来自 10 万商品对代理实验，不能等同真实线上 CTR 收益。
papers.scoring_rationale: LLM 推荐推理的低成本迁移路径清楚，有人工基准、置信区间及匹配监督对照；商品升级需改写为社区内容偏好，组合式方法新颖性为 3。
papers.track_rationale: 属于 LLM 推荐推理的蒸馏落地研究：教师生成关系与理由，学生为非生成式分类器，报告明确这一边界。
papers.evidence_note: 全文表 1–4；AUC 0.941 对应每品类 K=32；没有线上 A/B。
papers.preference_reason: LLM 推荐推理的部分主题匹配 +0.15；业务与实用性维度各 +0.05。

papers.title: Repeated Queries Exhaust an LLM's Brand Recommendations but Not Its Sources
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.05059v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Whether repeated identical buying questions exhaust a language model's brand recommendations depends on retrieval. Across 300 question-engine cells (50 questions, six engines, 15 runs each, open extraction over 1,470 adjudicated organizations), the five engines answering without web search were still adding never-seen brands at run 15 in 86-92% of cells, with median repertoires of 15-31 organizations; the one retrieval-enabled engine closed its list (median 8 organizations, 64% of cells still adding), matching four earlier deep cells where web-search runs saturated by run ten. Cited-domain accumulation keeps rising at every horizon tested: four deep cells were still adding domains at run 24 with 59-84% of the Chao2 lower-bound estimate observed, and 44% of the retrieval engine's breadth cells were still adding domains at run 15. A single run shows 62-77% of the five-run brand set, and across engines the median question draws 38 organizat
papers.summary: 该研究用 50 个购买问题、6 个引擎和每题 15 次运行，检验 LLM 品牌推荐与引用来源是否随重复提问趋于饱和。单次回答仅覆盖五次运行品牌集合的 62%–77%；无检索引擎到第 15 次仍新增品牌的比例为 86%–92%，说明一次采样不足以判断推荐覆盖与稳定性。
papers.key_insight: 社区对话式推荐评估应把重复运行的内容覆盖、排序稳定性与引用覆盖分开统计，并使用开放实体抽取，避免预设名单制造虚假的饱和曲线。可在相同 query 下重复采样，比较候选重合率与 nDCG 方差；论文分析的是品牌可见性，未证明重复生成能够提升用户 CTR 或推荐满意度。
papers.scoring_rationale: 提供可复用的多次采样评测方法和开放抽取对照，代码与数据指针可见；品牌曝光分析与 UGC 相关性存在任务距离，业务和新颖性均为 3。
papers.track_rationale: 评测大模型作为推荐者的输出覆盖及稳定性，属于 LLM-as-recommender。
papers.evidence_note: 全文摘要、方法与表格；实验覆盖 300 个问题-引擎单元，非排序模型改进论文。
papers.preference_reason: LLM 推荐评测弱主题匹配 +0.10；实用性维度 +0.05。
